title: npm run verify is flaky: R18 render p95 8.6-8.7 ms > 8 budget; unit failed once
where: projects/tower-defense: npm run verify (perf step, unit step)
detail: Steps: 1. cd projects/tower-defense; npm ci && npm run build. 2. Run npm run verify three times on a clean box. Expected: green each time. Actual: run 1 FAIL unit + FAIL perf (R18 render frame p95 8.60 ms > 8), run 2 GREEN, run 3 FAIL perf (p95 8.70 ms > 8). Unit passed on isolated rerun (163/163), so the unit failure is load-sensitive. Ship gate (--strict) is unreliable; budget has no headroom. Evidence: verify output, evidence-local/perf/perf.json.

title: README controls omit that restart in pause needs a second R press
detail: Steps: play, Esc, press R. Expected per README 'R restart (in pause)': restart. Actual: first R only arms the button ('Press again to restart', tick unchanged, scene stays paused); second R restarts to R1/650/100 and returns to play. Works well, README just does not say so. Evidence: evidence/qa/after-r.jpg

title: UI text drops to ~8 px at 900x600 (spec: text >= 12 px)
detail: Steps: open ?test=1 at 900x600, press Play, place a Tern. Canvas scales to 0.703, so 12 px sidebar text renders ~8.4 px and the Satchel card names and costs are small. Expected: text legible at the 900x600 viewport the verify gate captures (experience.md section 15, text >= 12 px). Actual: scaled down proportionally with no minimum. Evidence: bureau/missions/M-0002-tower-defense-vertical-slice/evidence/qa/play-800x1000.jpg (scale 0.625 case).

title: Settings card: Auto-start row crowds the Back button and enemy legend strip
detail: Steps: title, click Settings. Expected: clear spacing between the last toggle row and the footer. Actual: 'Auto-start rounds' toggle sits ~20 px above the Back button/legend strip, the card bottom has no padding and the bottom row looks cramped. Cosmetic. Evidence: evidence/qa/settings.jpg

title: Test hook stage() after a manual retry lands on Round 1 instead of target stage
detail: Steps: ?test=1 load; stage('victory'); press Enter (retry, back to play); stage('r18-8s') then stage('title-idle') and click Settings. Expected: R18 board. Actual: board shows Round 1 ready (first-placement hint), and a later hook call advanced tick to 216187. Fresh page with stage('r18-8s') works. Likely a stale script driver/run left after retry. Test-harness only, not player-visible. Evidence: evidence/qa/r18.jpg when run on a fresh page is fine; failing capture seen in session.
